This specific issue was definitely fixed ages ago. Forgot this canny was even still open.

details: If you turn OSC off and then back on in game, VRChat stops sending packets to any ports that were previously connected via OSCQuery. If a new port number is used for the oscquery connection, it works fine, but even returning to the old port afterward remains broken.
title: Toggling OSC in game breaks all existing OSCQuery connections forever
